items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: But I went with Earl. I went with Earl Dancer.

ctx.x: Movie studios, yes. So he knew Busby Berkeley who had all of these big spectacular shows and millions of chorus girls dancing. So the band, Echols band kind of split. One went one way and the other went, the other stayed with Echols.
But I went with Earl. I went with Earl Dancer.
Now he wasn't a musician really?
